description: Utility module for handling OpenAPI schema generation compatibility with FastAPI 0.120+. It patches Pydantic's internal schema generation to handle non-serializable types like openai.Timeout gracefully, ensuring schema generation does not fail due to stricter FastAPI schema validation.

classes.name: GenerateSchema
classes.description: Internal Pydantic class responsible for schema generation, patched in this module to handle special cases.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_openapi_schema_with_compat( get_openapi_func, title: str, version: str, description: str, routes: list, )
methods.description: Main function that generates an OpenAPI schema, applying a patch to handle openai.Timeout types, and restoring the original schema generation method afterward.
